title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Thursday, 17 September 2026
description: Today: OpenAI launches its full-duplex GPT-Live-1 voice model as open-source Qwen 3.8 closes in on Claude Opus 4.6; Tony Burke delivers his migration overhaul speech as markets price in an RBA rate rise; Queensland passes its Circuit Breaker Sentencing bill and charges a man with 36 property offences; and the Gold Coast Suns manage their off-season list amid Ben King's expected departure. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
